parameters.query:
WITH all_cases_last_7d AS (
  SELECT 
    incident_type AS case_type,
    priority,
    created_at,
    COALESCE(parcela, 'Sin parcela') AS location
  FROM forest_incidents
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    'PLAGA' AS case_type,
    severity AS priority,
    created_at,
    COALESCE(metadata->>'ubicacion_texto', 'Sin ubicación') AS location
  FROM pest_cases
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    'PERMISO' AS case_type,
    urgency AS priority,
    created_at,
    COALESCE(metadata->>'ubicacion_texto', 'Sin ubicación') AS location
  FROM permits
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    'PARTE_TRABAJO' AS case_type,
    'BAJA' AS priority,
    created_at,
    COALESCE(location_text, 'Sin ubicación') AS location
  FROM work_reports
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
),

all_cases_last_30d AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(parcela, 'Sin parcela') AS location,
    created_at
  FROM forest_incidents
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    COALESCE(metadata->>'ubicacion_texto', 'Sin ubicación') AS location,
    created_at
  FROM pest_cases
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    COALESCE(metadata->>'ubicacion_texto', 'Sin ubicación') AS location,
    created_at
  FROM permits
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    COALESCE(location_text, 'Sin ubicación') AS location,
    created_at
  FROM work_reports
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
),

incidents_last_7d AS (
  SELECT 
    case_type AS incident_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN priority = 'ALTA' THEN 1 END) AS alta,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN priority = 'MEDIA' THEN 1 END) AS media,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN priority = 'BAJA' THEN 1 END) AS baja
  FROM all_cases_last_7d
  GROUP BY case_type
  ORDER BY total DESC
),

alerts_last_7d AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN fire_risk = 'EXTREMO' THEN 1 END) AS extremo,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN fire_risk = 'ALTO' THEN 1 END) AS alto,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN fire_risk = 'MODERADO' THEN 1 END) AS moderado,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN fire_risk = 'BAJO' THEN 1 END) AS bajo
  FROM fire_alerts
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND alert_sent = true
),

legal_last_7d AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM queries
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
),

top_locations_30d AS (
  SELECT 
    location,
    COUNT(*) AS incidents
  FROM all_cases_last_30d
  GROUP BY location
  ORDER BY incidents DESC
  LIMIT 5
)

SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) FROM incidents_last_7d) AS total_incidents,
  (SELECT COALESCE(total, 0) FROM alerts_last_7d) AS total_alerts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(total, 0) FROM legal_last_7d) AS total_legal_queries,
  (SELECT json_agg(incidents_last_7d) FROM incidents_last_7d) AS incidents_by_type,
  (SELECT row_to_json(alerts_last_7d) FROM alerts_last_7d) AS alerts_summary,
  (SELECT json_agg(top_locations_30d) FROM top_locations_30d) AS top_locations,
  NOW() AS generated_at;
